description: Either person can pass without explaining.

endScreen.title: You Look Different Now
endScreen.subtitle: Keep what became more real between you.

notice.name: What We Notice

underneath.name: What Sits Underneath
underneath.description: Stories, choices, and contradictions beneath the surface

between.name: What Is Here Between Us
between.description: What this conversation is revealing about both of you

questions.question: What part of your day would you be happy for someone to ask about?
more: What made that part matter today?
What would you leave out in a casual answer?

questions.question: What small detail helps you feel welcome somewhere new?
more: When did someone last notice that detail for you?

questions.question: What do people tend to read correctly about you when they first meet you?
more: How do you think you communicate it without words?

questions.question: What do people confidently get wrong about you?
more: What do you do that helps create that misunderstanding?
Do you ever benefit from it?

questions.question: What do you make look easy that actually costs you effort?
more: Why is it important that other people do not see the effort?

questions.question: When you meet someone new, which version of you arrives first?
more: Which version takes longer to appear?

questions.question: Which compliment do you trust, and which one makes you suspicious?
more: What does your suspicion protect you from?

questions.question: What are you curious about but usually too polite to ask?
more: Ask it now if it feels fair.
The other person may answer, reshape it, or pass.

questions.question: What ordinary thing do you care about more than most people?
more: Tell the story of how it became important to you.

questions.question: What kind of silence feels comfortable to you?
more: Who taught you that silence could be safe?

questions.question: Choose an object you can see. Tell the story that makes it more than an object.
more: Do not choose the most impressive object.
Let the other person ask one follow-up question.

questions.question: Finish this sentence without making it charming: You might not guess that I...
more: Pause before you soften the ending.
The other person only says: Tell me more.

questions.question: What is a kindness you still remember in unreasonable detail?
more: Which detail stayed with you?
What did it let you believe for a moment?

questions.question: Tell me about a recent moment that changed your mind.
more: What made you willing to be changed?

questions.question: Which younger version of you deserves more credit?
more: What were they carrying that nobody could see?

questions.question: What belief have you outgrown without fully replacing?
more: What still feels useful about the old belief?

questions.question: What rule do you still follow even though you no longer believe in it?
more: Who benefits when you keep following it?
What would breaking it cost you?

questions.question: What dream have you edited down until it sounds reasonable?
more: What did the less reasonable version ask of you?

questions.question: What truth do you know but keep living as if you do not?
more: What convenience does not knowing protect?

questions.question: What do you complain about while protecting the thing that causes it?
more: What are you unwilling to lose?
Name the trade you are making.

questions.question: When did you say yes before you felt ready and become glad you did?
more: What helped you move before certainty arrived?

questions.question: Who shaped you without ever knowing how much they did?
more: What did you quietly borrow from them?

questions.question: Choose a photo that is not impressive. Tell the story outside its frame.
more: What happened five minutes before it?
What could the photo never show?

questions.question: Name one strength that sometimes becomes a hiding place.
more: Give a recent example.
Let the other person reflect what they heard before responding.

questions.question: Which answer has changed your picture of me so far?
more: What were you assuming before that answer?

questions.question: When in this conversation did you feel most listened to?
more: What did the other person do that made it feel different?

questions.question: What assumption about me are you now willing to revise?
more: Say the original assumption plainly.
Give me room to correct both versions.

questions.question: What are you saying more carefully because it is me sitting here?
more: What would the less careful version sound like?

questions.question: What feels easier to tell a stranger than someone close to you?
more: What becomes risky when the listener matters?

questions.question: Where do you think I might be performing confidence?
more: Offer it as a guess, not a diagnosis.
Let me keep, change, or reject your reading.

questions.question: What would you genuinely like me to ask next?
more: Why does that question matter now?

questions.question: What would make this conversation more honest than it has been?
more: Ask for one concrete change from both of you.

questions.question: What part of you feels a little safer after talking here?
more: What helped create that safety?

questions.question: What should we deliberately leave unopened today?
more: A boundary can be part of an honest conversation.
No explanation is required.

questions.question: Each name one moment when the other person seemed most alive.
more: Describe what you noticed.
Do not turn it into advice.

questions.question: Name one thing you now understand differently about the person in front of you.
more: Say what changed, not only what you learned.
Thank each other for one honest moment.
